many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import json
def comps(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    while True:
        s=None
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if g[i][j] and not seen[i][j]:
                    s=(i,j); break
            if s: break
        if s is None: break
        st=[s]; seen[s[0]][s[1]]=True; cs=[]; col=g[s[0]][s[1]]
        while st:
            y,x=st.pop(); cs.append((y,x))
            for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny][nx]==col and not seen[ny][nx]:
                    seen[ny][nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
        out.append(cs)
        for y,x in cs: g[y][x]=0
    return out
# Demo2 output shape4 has 6 cells - check connectivity carefully (maybe 2 components in one color)
ti=G['Demo pair 2 output']
print(comps(ti))
